steps: Combine the all-purpose flour and salt in a sieve, then add oil and water to make a smooth dough. Rest 15 minutes, divide into five and flatten each into a disk ready for frying.

Blend chopped chicken with turmeric, chilli powder, tandoori masala, ground cumin, ground coriander, lemon juice, mustard oil and salt. Cook in canola oil for 15 minutes, adding the tomato paste halfway through.
Oil a griddle, set a paratha on it, break an egg onto it and spread. Flip the paratha so the egg cooks through and fuses to the flatbread.
Chop cucumber and onion into thin slices, grate the carrots, and finely chop the green chilli and fresh coriander. Mix in a bowl.
Spread tomato and chilli sauce on the egg-lined flatbread, add the salad and chicken, sprinkle chaat masala, wrap firmly in wax paper and serve hot.
